title: 第五卷四十三血湖第五卷四十二雷云
content_zh:
野人星的雨季来了。
雨落林海，绵密无声，洗尽山林燥热，也压住了整片土地的气息。
阿木跪在义父的遗体前，膝盖深陷泥泞。
野人星的葬礼自古无声。原生族祖训，逝者灵魂悬于躯体三寸之上，静听最后一遍亲人心跳。哭声惊魂，是以举国禁泣，哀乐不兴。
阿木没有哭。
眼底干涸荒芜，像野人星历经大旱、寸草不生的河床。他依族中孝子规制，以粗草绳束起长发，额头一次次重重叩向泥水，泥污与暗红血痕糊住眉眼。
阿鲁静卧在芭蕉叶铺就的灵床上，身着野人星族长世代传承的羽衣。雨水打湿层层翎羽，贴身覆在他清瘦的肩头。老者双目轻阖，唇角微扬，是后辈成龙，安然满足的神情。
阿木记得义父口中所有故事。
如今，所有尘封岁月，都随他静静躺于雨幕之中。
阿木闭目，以额轻触义父冰凉的手背，作最后辞别。起身时双腿麻木僵直，身形骤然一晃，一只有力的手臂稳稳扶住了他。
是韩昌。
三百年卧底磨出的世俗笑意尽收，此刻的他褪去所有温润伪装，立在雨里，如一柄彻底归鞘的长剑，笔直、沉默、锋芒内敛。
身侧惜若静立，白衣不染雨浊。她睫毛轻颤，唇齿微动，诵出一段极短的往生咒。
人群最边缘，霓依孤身伫立雨水中。
一袭素黑束腰长裙，不撑伞、不避雨，任由雨丝从鬓角滑落，浸透衣领。这位联邦情报部权倾朝野的掌舵人，极少公开涉足凡尘俗事，今日默然立于泥泞之中，脊背挺直如松。
她只对阿木轻轻颔首。
一言未发，却又千帆渡尽。
野人星的葬礼极简至极。
无纸钱，无爆竹，无管弦哀乐。唯余篝火。
部落三千近亲族人尽数到场，每人添薪柴一根，层层堆叠，垒成一个巨大山冢。阿木执起火把，雨中风头微颤，火光跳跃须臾，便稳稳落于大柴堆之上。

火苗窜起，穿透湿冷雨雾，灼灼不灭。
篝火彻夜通明。阿木寸步不离，静守整夜。
天霁雨歇，天光破晓，薪火燃尽成灰。阿木俯身，将义父骨灰一捧一捧，稳稳盛入陶瓮。
这双手，是联邦珍视的至宝。能驯服上古异兽，能校准灵石矿脉共振，能让星域顶尖学者俯身求教，是欧阳力亲自敲定、支撑联邦未来发展的核心根基。
此刻这双手捧起一罐骨灰，将陶瓮紧紧贴于心口，转身踏出部落山门。
门外，双头豹双双伏身等候，两颗头颅同时低下，柔软皮毛轻轻蹭过他的肩头，温顺无声。阿木翻身上豹背，抬眼望向遥远的紫月星方向。
眼底依旧无泪，干涸深处，却藏着一簇星火。
火起于野人星千年篝火，淬炼于联邦无数深夜灯火，历经生死离别沉淀，此刻渺小，却足以焚尽虚空黑暗。
双双昂首，两声长啸破开晨间薄雾，几人一豹，转瞬消融在林海晨雾深处。
——
紫月星，联邦指挥中心。
巨型星图投影横贯整面墙壁，星域对峙线紧绷如弦，一触即断。
自结盟落幕，渊尘边境挑衅从未停歇。
舰队贴线游弋、寸分不差，不越界、不开火、不通讯，以最规矩的姿态，行最恶意的施压。直至天狗军团全境升空，隔离带僵局彻底锁死。
外人所见，是渊尘冥顽不灵、死硬凶悍，摆明不惜举国开战，也要与联邦、龙族死磕到底。
隔离带战场，天狗军团不再试探。
content_en:
The rainy season of Savage Star is here.
The rain fell on the forest sea, making no sound, washing away the heat of the mountains and forests, and suppressing the breath of the entire land.
Amu knelt in front of his adoptive father's body, his knees dug into the mud.
The funeral of Savage Star has been silent since ancient times. According to the ancestral teachings of the native tribes, the soul of the deceased hangs three inches above the body, listening to the last heartbeat of the loved one. The cry was so frightening that the whole country was forbidden to weep, and no one was happy or sad.
Amu didn't cry.
The eyes are dry and barren, like a riverbed on Savage Planet that has experienced severe drought and is barren of grass. In accordance with the rules of a filial son in the clan, he tied up his long hair with a thick straw rope and knocked his forehead heavily against the muddy water again and again. Mud and dark red blood stains covered his eyebrows.
Aru was lying quietly on a spiritual bed paved with banana leaves, wearing a feathered garment passed down from generation to generation by the patriarch of the Savage Star. The rain wetted the layers of feathers and covered his thin shoulders. The old man's eyes were lightly closed and the corners of his lips were slightly raised, showing the peaceful and contented look of his younger generation, Jackie Chan.
Amu remembered all the stories told by his adoptive father.
Now, all the dusty years lie quietly with him in the rain.
Amu closed his eyes, gently touched the back of his adoptive father's cold hand with his forehead, and said his last goodbyes. When he stood up, his legs were numb and stiff, and his body suddenly swayed, and a strong arm held him steady.
It's Han Chang.
The worldly smile honed by three hundred years of undercover service has disappeared. At this moment, he has shed all his gentle pretense and stands in the rain, like a long sword that has been completely sheathed, straight, silent, and with a restrained edge.
Standing quietly beside me, my white clothes are not stained by the rain. Her eyelashes quivered, her lips and teeth moved slightly, and she recited a very short rebirth mantra.
At the edge of the crowd, Niyi stood alone in the rain.
Wearing a plain black long skirt with a waist, she did not hold an umbrella or shelter from the rain, letting the rain slip down from her temples and soak into her collar. The powerful head of the federal intelligence agency, who rarely publicly engages in mundane affairs, stood silently in the mud today, his back as straight as a pine tree.
She only nodded slightly to Amu.
Not a word was spoken, but thousands of sails sailed across the river.
Savage Star's funeral is as simple as it gets.
No paper money, no firecrackers, no orchestral music. Only the bonfire remains.
All three thousand close relatives of the tribe came to the scene, and each person added a piece of firewood, which was piled on top of each other to form a huge mountain tomb. Amu held up the torch, his head trembling slightly in the rain. The fire jumped for a moment, and then fell steadily on the big pile of firewood.
The flames shot up, penetrated the wet, cold rain and mist, and burned unquenchably.
The bonfire was lit all night. Amu stayed close to him and stayed silent all night.
The sky has stopped and the rain has stopped, the sky has broken, and the firewood has burned out and turned to ashes. Amu leaned over, took handfuls of his adoptive father's ashes, and put them firmly into the pottery urn.
These hands are a treasure cherished by the Federation. Being able to tame ancient beasts, calibrate the resonance of spirit stone veins, and enable top scholars in the star field to lean in and ask for advice is the core foundation that Ouyang Li has personally determined to support the future development of the federation.
At this moment, these hands held a jar of ashes, held the pottery urn tightly to his heart, turned around and stepped out of the tribal gate.
Outside the door, two-headed leopards were waiting, their heads lowered at the same time, their soft fur gently brushing against his shoulders, gentle and silent. Amu rolled over on his leopard back and raised his eyes to look in the direction of the distant Purple Moon Star.
There were still no tears in his eyes, but there was a cluster of sparks hidden in the dry depths.
The fire started from the thousand-year bonfire on the Savage Star, was tempered by countless late-night lights in the Federation, and settled after life and death. It was small at the moment, but it was enough to burn away the darkness of the void.
They both raised their heads, and two long roars broke through the morning mist. A few people and a leopard melted into the depths of the forest and morning mist.
——
Purple Moon Star, Federal Command Center.
The giant star map is projected across the entire wall, and the line of confrontation in the star field is as tight as a string, and can be broken at the touch of a touch.
Since the end of the alliance, Yuanchen's border provocations have never stopped.
The fleet cruised closely to the line, not missing an inch, not crossing the line, not firing, and not communicating. It exerted the most malicious pressure in the most disciplined manner. Until the entire Tengu Legion took off, the deadlock in the isolation zone was completely locked.
What outsiders saw was that Yuan Chen was stubborn, stubborn and fierce. He made it clear that he would fight to the end with the Federation and the Dragon Clan even if the whole country went to war.
In the isolation zone battlefield, the Tengu Legion no longer tries。
